Set this board up for Knit?

This adds the Knit channel to your board and changes a few of its settings: it renames the board “Knit” so you can pick it out on the mesh, stops broadcasting its position and node info, and stops relaying other radios' traffic to save battery.

It also marks the board “unmonitored”. Knit only reads Knit's own messages, so an ordinary Meshtastic message sent to this board would never reach you — the mark tells other people's apps that, instead of letting them write to a board nobody is reading.

Your board's own main channel is left alone and it stays on the public Meshtastic frequency, so other radios can still pass your messages along.

This room shows the primary channel of the Meshtastic radio paired to this phone. Knit\'s encryption does not reach it: nothing here is end-to-end encrypted, and on the standard Meshtastic channel the key is public, so anyone with a radio can read it. Anyone with a radio in range can post and anyone can claim any name, so treat both as unverified, even a name that matches one of your contacts. The one exception is a contact\'s name with a shield beside it: their radio signed that post, and the signature checked out against the radio their profile names. A matching name without the shield is still a guess. Some posts arrive from the Internet rather than from anyone nearby. What you post here leaves through your own radio, under the radio\'s name rather than yours.
